import json, re, sys, zipfile, shutil, os

SRC = 'inputs/offer_letter_template.docx'
DATA = 'inputs/employee_data.json'
OUT = 'output/offer_letter_filled.docx'

# ---- load data ----
with open(DATA, encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Fields that may act as fallbacks/aliases but must NEVER be used for the conditional.
FORBIDDEN_ALIASES = {'RELOCATION', 'RELOCATION_PACKAGE_BACKUP'}

PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(r'\{\{([A-Z_]+)\}\}')
# Conditional block: {{IF_RELOCATION}} ... {{END_IF_RELOCATION}} (single paragraph, non-greedy)
COND_RE = re.compile(r'\{\{IF_RELOCATION\}\}(.*?)\{\{END_IF_RELOCATION\}\}', re.S)

missing = []

def resolve_text(text):
    """Apply conditional first, then simple placeholders, on concatenated paragraph text."""
    # Handle conditional block(s)
    def cond_sub(m):
        inner = m.group(1)
        if 'RELOCATION_PACKAGE' not in data:
            missing.append('RELOCATION_PACKAGE (governs IF_RELOCATION)')
            return m.group(0)  # leave; will fail later
        keep = (data['RELOCATION_PACKAGE'] == 'Yes')  # exact string only
        return inner if keep else ''
    text = COND_RE.sub(cond_sub, text)

    # Simple placeholders
    def ph_sub(m):
        name = m.group(1)
        if name in FORBIDDEN_ALIASES:
            # These are never valid placeholders to fill; but if present in doc, treat as missing requirement
            missing.append(f'{name} (forbidden alias used as placeholder)')
            return m.group(0)
        if name not in data:
            missing.append(name)
            return m.group(0)
        return str(data[name])
    text = PLACEHOLDER_RE.sub(ph_sub, text)
    return text

RUN_T_RE = re.compile(r'(<w:t\b[^>]*>)(.*?)(</w:t>)', re.S)

def process_paragraph(p_xml):
    """Collect <w:t> texts, replace on concatenation, redistribute (all into first t, rest emptied)."""
    matches = list(RUN_T_RE.finditer(p_xml))
    if not matches:
        return p_xml
    combined = ''.join(m.group(2) for m in matches)
    if '{{' not in combined:
        return p_xml
    new_combined = resolve_text(combined)
    # Rebuild: put entire new text into first <w:t>, empty the others.
    # Preserve xml:space on first t; ensure space preservation.
    out = []
    last = 0
    for i, m in enumerate(matches):
        out.append(p_xml[last:m.start()])
        open_tag, _old, close_tag = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        if i == 0:
            # force xml:space preserve
            if 'xml:space' not in open_tag:
                open_tag = open_tag[:-1] + ' xml:space="preserve">'
            content = xml_escape(new_combined)
        else:
            if 'xml:space' not in open_tag:
                open_tag = open_tag[:-1] + ' xml:space="preserve">'
            content = ''
        out.append(open_tag + content + close_tag)
        last = m.end()
    out.append(p_xml[last:])
    return ''.join(out)

def xml_escape(s):
    return s.replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>')

PARA_RE = re.compile(r'<w:p\b.*?</w:p>', re.S)

def process_xml(xml):
    return PARA_RE.sub(lambda m: process_paragraph(m.group(0)), xml)

# ---- process all relevant parts ----
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')
parts = {}
TARGET_PARTS = []
for name in zin.namelist():
    if name == 'word/document.xml' or re.match(r'word/(header|footer)\d+\.xml$', name):
        TARGET_PARTS.append(name)

new_contents = {}
for name in TARGET_PARTS:
    xml = zin.read(name).decode('utf-8')
    new_contents[name] = process_xml(xml)

# ---- validate required fields present ----
if missing:
    uniq = sorted(set(missing))
    sys.stderr.write('ERROR: missing required field(s): ' + ', '.join(uniq) + '\n')
    zin.close()
    sys.exit(2)

# ---- write output preserving everything else ----
os.makedirs('output', exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        name = item.filename
        if name in new_contents:
            zout.writestr(item, new_contents[name].encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            zout.writestr(item, zin.read(name))
zin.close()
print('Wrote', OUT)
